name: TS391SNL
reference: Chip Quik TS391SNL datasheet rev 1.2 (Sn96.5/Ag3.0/Cu0.5, mp 217-220 C); curve derived from data/oven-characterisation.json
notes: The paste's own recommended profile asks for ramps this oven does not have. Chip Quik's chart wants 175->217 C in 30 s (1.40 C/s) and 217->249 C in 30 s (1.07 C/s); measured full-power capability in those bands is about 0.90 and 0.70 C/s. Running the datasheet curve would miss both ramps and produce a joint nobody characterised, so this is built from measured capability instead. Rise segments are set to 80% of the measured full-power rate so the controller has headroom rather than saturating; the soak is deliberately slower. The peak is held briefly to buy time above liquidus, which the oven cannot earn on the way up. The cooling tail matches measured door-shut cooling, so it is achievable unattended; opening the door beats it and is preferable. Peak is 235 C against the datasheet's 249 C. 249 C has never been demonstrated on this oven -- the step tests reached 240 C -- so the peak sits inside measured ground rather than beyond it.
